role: Senior IT Infrastructure Consultant - English speaking
companyNotes: PERSOL Thailand is hiring for an English-speaking consultant role supporting client companies with IT infrastructure services, troubleshooting, consulting, security assessments, AI-based solutions, training, and project coordination.
jobDescription: Senior IT Infrastructure Consultant role in Bangkok. Responsibilities include requirement gathering, solution proposal, infrastructure design, architecture planning, system implementation, deployment, operation, maintenance, monitoring support, troubleshooting for server systems, network infrastructure and security solutions, web security assessments, IT environment surveys, IT consulting, AI-based solution implementation support, client training, client and internal team coordination, on-site support, business trips, managing multiple projects, service quality, deadlines, and continuous learning. Requirements include over 5 years of IT infrastructure experience in server, network, or security, good English, self-motivation, collaboration, curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies.
letter: I am interested in the Senior IT Infrastructure Consultant - English speaking role at PERSOL Thailand because it connects well with the kind of work I enjoy: understanding client needs, solving practical technical problems, and helping teams deliver reliable systems. The role's mix of infrastructure services, consulting, troubleshooting, security-related work, AI-based solutions, and client training is meaningful to me because it requires both technical ability and clear communication.

In my current work as a Software Engineer, I work across backend systems, cloud deployment, and DevOps support. I build and maintain services, support production releases, troubleshoot issues, and improve delivery workflows using AWS, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD practices. I have also worked with medical technology, document workflows, AI utilities, and database systems, which has helped me become comfortable learning new domains and turning technical requirements into practical solutions.

What attracts me most to this position is the opportunity to work directly with clients from requirement gathering through implementation, operation, and improvement. I believe good consulting is not only about giving technical answers, but also about listening carefully, explaining options clearly, managing expectations, and following through until the system works reliably. My academic background in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, together with my master's study in telecommunication and networking systems, also gives me a strong foundation for infrastructure, networks, and system behavior.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to PERSOL Thailand's client projects and continue growing in an environment that values English communication, teamwork, curiosity, and continuous learning. Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss how my software engineering, cloud, DevOps, AI-related, and networking background can contribute to this role.
